verdict.rationale: Vast.ai docs explicitly describe 'Volumes' as persistent storage that survives instance destruction and can be reattached to new instances, directly matching the story. However, a community user notes wishing it were 'easier to work with persistent disks over time' and now avoids it for anything but one-off jobs, indicating real friction in practice. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of volume reattachment reliability, docs detailing size/performance limits, and broader community corroboration beyond a single anecdotal complaint.
